description: Build a private static Vulkan ICD with upstream Subzero Reactor; do not configure unused LLVM backends or emit misleading DLL/ICD aliases

replacements.after:
/* XLWebEngineUI: musl does not provide glibc execinfo/backtrace. */
#if defined(__GLIBC__)
#define HAVE_BACKTRACE 1
#endif

/* XLWebEngineUI: the checked-in Linux config must also support musl. */
#if defined(__GLIBC__)
#define HAVE_MALLINFO 1
#endif

if(REACTOR_BACKEND STREQUAL "LLVM")
    add_subdirectory(${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/llvm-${SWIFTSHADER_LLVM_VERSION} EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    set_target_properties(llvm PROPERTIES FOLDER "third_party")
endif()

# XLWebEngineUI: real static ICD, no DLL aliases or external JSON manifest.
return()

// XLWebEngineUI: private static LLVM; no COFF /include of unprefixed debugger helpers.
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#define LLVM_DUMP_METHOD LLVM_ATTRIBUTE_NOINLINE
#else
#define LLVM_DUMP_METHOD LLVM_ATTRIBUTE_NOINLINE LLVM_ATTRIBUTE_USED
#endif
